TABLE.NAME: authorcheck
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the authorcheck activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity description.

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: The format of the intro field.

FIELD.NAME: releasetime
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time at which questions auto-release. 0 = no scheduled release.

FIELD.NAME: manualreleased
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 = lecturer has manually released questions now, overriding the schedule.

FIELD.NAME: maxattempts
FIELD.COMMENT: How many times a student may submit answers (1-3).

FIELD.NAME: flagthreshold
FIELD.COMMENT: Percent of objective questions a student must reach to avoid being flagged.

FIELD.NAME: numquestions
FIELD.COMMENT: How many questions to generate from the submission (3-12).

FIELD.NAME: submissiondeadline
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time upload cutoff. After this, questions are generated. 0 = no deadline.

FIELD.NAME: assignmentid
FIELD.COMMENT: Linked mod_assign instance id to draw submissions from. 0 = none.

FIELD.NAME: timelimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Answer time limit in minutes once a student starts. 0 = no limit.

FIELD.NAME: qtypes
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated question types to generate.

TABLE.NAME: authorcheck_attempts
TABLE.COMMENT: One row per student per activity: score and authorship flag

FIELD.NAME: authorcheckid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to authorcheck instance

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to the student

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=notstarted 1=inprogress 2=submitted 3=reviewed

FIELD.NAME: attemptsused
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of times the student has submitted answers.

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: Computed objective score

FIELD.NAME: maxscore
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum possible objective score

FIELD.NAME: flagged
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if below authorship threshold

FIELD.NAME: nosubmission
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the student made no usable assignment submission.

FIELD.NAME: unprocessable
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if the submitted file yielded no extractable text (e.g. scanned PDF).

FIELD.NAME: timestarted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the student first opened the answer form (timer start).

FIELD.NAME: timegenerated
FIELD.COMMENT: When questions were generated

TABLE.NAME: authorcheck_questions
TABLE.COMMENT: Generated questions belonging to an attempt

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to authorcheck_attempts

FIELD.NAME: options
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of choices for mcq

FIELD.NAME: answerkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Correct answer; null for open

TABLE.NAME: authorcheck_responses
TABLE.COMMENT: A student's answer to each question

FIELD.NAME: response
FIELD.COMMENT: Student's submitted answer

FIELD.NAME: iscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 correct, 0 incorrect, null for ungraded open
